Experimental explicit VAAPI H.264/HEVC and V4L2 M2M H.264; software/Auto defaults preserved
Portable FFmpeg/dependency packaging, install/upgrade guide, separate native amd64/arm64 packaged GUI/media CI

failedAttempts.scope:
Run a workflow in owned software-rendered GNOME, PipeWire and session bus.

qualificationLimits: Physical Wayland/compositor/permission revocation, pending Stop/Quit GNOME portal crash, covered-window and suspend/resume cases remain open; no desktop service was patched here.
Wayland monitor/cursor and granted desktop-wide shortcut execution need additional compositor coverage; unavailable portal fallback is separate from shortcut execution.
Actual VAAPI/V4L2 encoded output requires suitable hardware/drivers. Jetson/Pi, Intel/AMD devices and high-profile performance remain unqualified; encoder listings are only gates.
Selected PulseAudio process output moves do not qualify native PipeWire/JACK timing, received PCM continuity, or every device/driver route.
Physical camera/microphone/HDMI moving-media, transparent Linux producer/OBS alpha, other ARM output protocols, 60fps/high profiles and long endurance remain open in existing ledgers.
Windows/macOS runtime and native amd64 regression require those systems. Shared enum additions and save serialization are regression risks; existing architecture defaults remain unchanged.
Portable compatibility is bounded by glibc/GLIBCXX floors and observed userlands, not a universal Linux guarantee. No releases are published.
failuresPreserved: Initial cursor fixture XBM rejected by Tk; corrected to a Pillow-generated bitmap and retained failures.
Candidate reconnect observation started before fresh microphone samples; received audio resumed. Added reconnection UI state and a fresh-sample observation gate.
Owned Wayland dependency startup lacked a system bus and GTK typelib; corrected only the disposable environment.
Remembered-permission chooser changed initial focus; fixture now navigates only the active real portal dialog.
Wayland crop observer assumed a fixed undecorated size; replaced with measured pre-crop versus post-crop dimensions plus independently decoded source identities.

Owned portal startup activated its default keyring after baseline owners were recorded; preactivate owned desktop services before recording owners. Application workflow passed but outer fixture failure is retained.
A /proc process disappeared during observer read; handle ESRCH as a retired process.
PulseAudio 15 JSON module listing omits module indexes; use its short module listing for owned device removal.
Recreating the virtual microphone replaces its own master-monitor stream ID. Cleanup observer now tracks only the verified owned module replacement; earlier apparent-leak failures are retained.

Audio-app chooser observer used a field label while this Qt accessibility implementation exposes its selected value. Select by the observed value and snapshot the helper per run; the helper can also verify a selected row for static labels.
Qt 6.2/6.4 lack qtestwheel.h and the gate contained Windows-only assertions. Ported simulator input and capability assertions; intermediate gate failures retained.
